at_least_3_external_cells.evidence: EIS session folders exist, but measurement filenames contain no physical cell ID and the frozen local manifest did not preserve the dataset folder hierarchy needed for a defensible cell join.

same_cell_fresh_and_later_eis.evidence: The official design repeats two discharge cycles on nominally new cells; no fresh-versus-aged checkpoint variable exists in the EIS files.

five_second_rint_increase_percent.evidence: EIS schemas expose Frequency, R, X, V, T, and range only. Capacity logs include one constant-current discharge per battery, not fresh and current five-second resistance measurements at each EIS checkpoint and SOC.

ocv_after_45_min_and_delta_from_fresh.evidence: EIS files include a V field but do not document the frozen 45-minute relaxation rule or provide fresh/current OCV checkpoint pairs.

same_cell_fresh_and_current_capacity.evidence: Exactly one capacity result is present for each BATT1-BATT11, so same-cell SOH relative to a measured fresh capacity cannot be formed.

comparable_full_equivalent_aging_cycles.evidence: The dataset has two repeated discharge cycles, not longitudinal aging-cycle checkpoints comparable to the frozen 0-to-400-cycle feature.

reason: Cassino cannot instantiate the frozen longitudinal calibration-aware inputs or SOH target. Scoring it would require changing the model contract after holdout inspection.
claim_boundary: Useful independent EIS/SOC dataset, but not a valid external test of this frozen missing-measurement pipeline.
next_action: Keep Cassino as a documented negative qualification. Locate an untouched longitudinal dataset with same-cell fresh/later EIS, 5-second pulse resistance, rested OCV, and measured capacity.
